highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: The California Institute of Advanced Management (CIAM) is an innovative institution located in the heart of California. It offers cutting-edge programs in management, leadership, and business administration.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: CIAM is known for its small class sizes and provides you with personalised learning experiences. The campus offers a vibrant learning environment with students from all over the world. Plus, you can choose from over 100 student clubs and organisations, getting global exposure.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
CIAM does not offer on-campus housing, but there are various off-campus housing options nearby, including private apartments, shared housing, and student accommodations.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
CIAM’s digital library – the Library Information Resources Network (LIRN) Consortium – is designed to support your academic journey, offering a wide range of resources including books, journals, and online materials to help you with coursework and research.
